criteria.AC1: rafting threshold stress vs field observation (Keinonen et al. 1996), |rel err| < 0.15; measured at half climb of a 45-degree ramp, h=0.5 m, L=6 m, mu=0.3
criteria.AC2: ridge sail/keel ratio vs observation (Timco & Burden 1994), |rel err| < 0.10, chain must be stable
criteria.AC3: Brazil-nut segregation timescale (63.2% rise) vs experiment (Shinbrot et al. 1996 regime), |rel err| < 0.10
criteria.AC4: reverse Brazil-nut phase boundary vs experiment (Hong, Quinn & Luding 2001), boundary must lie in the reported window
criteria.AC5: negative control: no vibration -> no segregation (drift < 25% of the shaken signal)

operational_definitions.tau_raft: piston line load divided by thickness at leading-edge climb = 0.5 h
operational_definitions.tau_deg: free-surface (top 25% of filled bed) area-weighted large-fraction enrichment
operational_definitions.tau_seg: cycles at which |dz| reaches 63.2% of its late-time asymptote (tail 25% mean)
operational_definitions.rbne_boundary: linear interpolation of the dz sign change along density ratio at fixed Gamma

anchors.rafting_onset_h050: 1.5e4 Pa, range 1.0e4-2.5e4 Pa (Keinonen et al. 1996 compilation, scatter +/-50%)
anchors.segregation_timescale: 30 cycles, range 15-60 (few tens of cycles; scatter +/-50%)

no_post_hoc_tuning: anchors and the measurement points were fixed before the campaign; the two honest FAILs (AC1, AC2) are reported as they came out
